description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars or fortune claims. Call when the user asks 能量怎么调 / 个人今天该推还是该收 / 团队这周该不该硬上线 / personal vs company rhythm. Same engine, two seats: personal (sleep/load) or org (window push vs hold). Not HR scoring, not medical treatment. Public · local · no API key. Preview ≠ prediction.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

hour.description: Optional hour for the personal seat (HH:MM or 时支).

month.description: Month YYYY-MM for the org seat. Default: current month.

seat.description: personal (default) = body load/sleep. org = team window, push vs hold.
